project_type: Expo managed workflow ~48.0.11, React Native 0.71.14, NativeWind 2.x, Redux Toolkit, Firebase Firestore v9 modular SDK
build_system: Expo EAS Build. No compile step on local machine. eas.json defines 'preview' (APK, internal) and 'production' (AAB). NPM_FLAGS='--legacy-peer-deps' is already set in eas.json env for preview/production profiles.
test_framework: None — no test runner is configured. Verification is done via 'npx expo config --type introspect' (confirms no crash) and visual inspection.
verification_instructions: 1. From c:\Users\user\Music\MyTruck-Production-Structured\apps\customer-app run: npx expo config --type introspect 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 20  — must complete without 'Error' or 'SyntaxError'. 2. After all FEATs, run: npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile preview --non-interactive  and capture the build URL from stdout.
environment_constraints: DO NOT change tailwindcss (must stay 3.2.7), postcss (must stay 8.4.31), or any Expo/RN package version. DO NOT touch babel.config.js, postcss.config.js, firebase.js, contexts/AuthContext.js, eas.json build profiles, or app.json package/owner/Firebase config. @react-navigation/bottom-tabs is NOT in node_modules — install it with: cd c:\Users\user\Music\MyTruck-Production-Structured\apps\customer-app && npm install @react-navigation/bottom-tabs --legacy-peer-deps  before using it. expo-constants IS already in node_modules (used by firebase.js).
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing business logic. Fix broken interactions, do not remove them. Use brand colors: Primary #179B83, Accent #F47721, Dark #0B2A26, Light BG #F5FAF9. Font weight: 800 headings, 700 labels, 600 body.
key_patterns: 1. Screens use NativeWind className props (tailwind utility classes). Inline StyleSheet.create is used only when className is insufficient. 2. Firebase calls use the v9 modular SDK (doc, getDoc, getDocs, collection, query, where, onSnapshot, updateDoc, serverTimestamp, orderBy, limit from 'firebase/firestore'). 3. Auth context is at contexts/AuthContext.js — export UserAuth() hook, dbUser object has .role, .firstName, .lastName, .uid, .sellerId, .sellerType, .approvalStatus, .phoneVerified. signOutUser() is on the context. 4. Redux store at store.js with basketSlice, restaurantSlice, userSlice. selectBasketItems returns array. 5. Navigation: createNativeStackNavigator from @react-navigation/native-stack. Stack screen names: Home, Restaurant, Basket, Options, Profile, Order Details, PreparingOrderScreen, ProductDelivery. 6. MapView with UrlTile pattern (no provider prop, add UrlTile child with urlTemplate). GEBETA_TILE_URL = 'https://mapapi.gebeta.app/api/v1/route/tile/{z}/{x}/{y}/?apiKey=KEY' where KEY = Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.gebetaMapsApiKey. Import Constants from 'expo-constants'. 7. All Firestore order docs have: userId, restaurantId, status (PENDING|ACCEPTED|DECLINED|PREPARING|READY|DRIVERACCEPTED|DRIVERPICKEDUP|COMPLETE), createdAt, customerName, total, deliveryAddress. 8. Seller/driver identity: dbUser.sellerId is the doc ID in 'restaurants' or 'shops' collection. dbUser.uid is the Firebase Auth UID and 'user' collection doc ID.
directory_structure: customer-app/ — Expo app root. screens/ — all screen components. components/ — shared UI components. navigation/ — RootNavigator, AppStack, AuthStack. features/ — Redux slices (basket, restaurant, user). contexts/ — AuthContext. assets/ — images, featuredData.json. firebase.js — Firebase init. store.js — Redux store. .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts (this directory, outside the worktree for commits).
